modalities.evidence: Penn fractal n-back task five-echo fMRI data

output.population: 8 participants, each with between 1 and 3 sessions; ages 21–30
output.summary: Pilot comparison of single-echo and complex-valued multi-echo BOLD acquisitions, with T1-weighted anatomical scans, an n-back task, and resting scans, intended for protocol evaluation, test-retest reliability, and denoising method development.
